value.rationale: The exact u+epsilon formula gives the full minimal-face stratification and a necessary-and-sufficient extreme-point test on every finite real metric with a bounded-Lipschitz sum norm. It directly addresses a previously identified gap and counterexample to local sufficiency in Hille--Theewis Section 6, and gives a quadratic-time graph recognition procedure without generic vertex enumeration. The opposing-anchor coupling and disconnected-tight-graph vertex phenomenon are substantive structural distinctions from older pure-Lipschitz graph tests.
